title: Phoenix and the Orange Orb
description: A dark-skinned woman in a black and patterned robe stands in a surreal landscape, holding a glowing red-orange orb with circular patterns. A massive dark blue phoenix with fiery accents flies above her, carrying another orange orb in its beak while a smaller bird rides a comet across a vibrant twilight sky.
prompt: A majestic dark blue phoenix with glowing yellow eyes and fiery orange accents flies across a vibrant twilight sky filled with comets and ancient ruins. In the foreground, a dark-skinned woman wearing a black robe with colorful patterns stands holding a glowing red orb patterned with circles. The landscape is filled with surreal orange slice-like flowers and foliage under a dramatic colorful sky, highly detailed surreal fantasy scene.
